Name: Smart Range Overlay 2.0
Author: astro2617
Description:
This is a complete, from-scratch rewrite of the original "Smart Range Overlay" mod, updated and modernized for Stardew Valley 1.6. 
The original mod was a must-have, but it has been hidden and outdated for a while. I loved the idea, so I recreated it and added highly requested features!

[size=4][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Farming Overlay:[/b] See the exact coverage of Sprinklers, Scarecrows, Bee Houses, and Lightning Rods.
[*] [b]Bomb Danger Zones (NEW):[/b] Displays a red warning grid for bombs in your hands AND bombs you've already placed on the ground (ticking bombs). Never blow up your crops again!
[*] [b]Tool Trajectories (NEW):[/b] Displays a blue directional grid for your Watering Can and Hoe depending on their upgrade level and where you are facing.
[*] [b]Smart Toggle:[/b] Press [b]Shift + R[/b] (by default) to instantly toggle the overlay on or off during gameplay.
[*] [b]Fully Customizable:[/b] Built-in support for Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM). Turn specific item overlays on or off to suit your playstyle.
[*] [b]Multiplayer Safe:[/b] Client-side only. You can use it in multiplayer without the host or other players needing to install it.
[/list]
[size=4][b]🌍 Languages[/b][/size]
Includes full translation for:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Russian (Русский)
[*]Ukrainian (Українська)
[/list]
[size=4][b]⚙️ Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ 4.0.0+
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Highly recommended)
[/list]
[size=4][b]🤝 Credits & Ethics[/b][/size]
This mod was coded from scratch for SV 1.6 using modern SMAPI conventions. However, the core concept and original idea belong to the author of the classic "Smart Range Overlay". All credit for the original design goes to them!
